# `github_pr`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] github_pr`

Create, list, view, or merge GitHub Pull Requests via the REST API. Token: tool arg, GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN, `gh auth login`, or stored git credentials.

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `create`, `list`, `view`, `merge` | yes | Action to perform on pull requests |
| `base` | string | no | [create] Target branch for the PR (e.g. 'main') |
| `body` | string | no | [create] PR description/body text |
| `head` | string | no | [create] Branch name containing the changes (e.g. 'feature-branch') |
| `method` | one of `merge`, `squash`, `rebase` | no | [merge] Merge method to use |
| `owner` | string | yes | Repository owner (user or organization) |
| `pr_number` | integer | no | [view \| merge] Pull request number |
| `repo` | string | yes | Repository name |
| `state` | one of `open`, `closed`, `all` | no | [list] Filter PRs by state |
| `title` | string | no | [create] PR title |
| `token` | string | no | GitHub token (optional). Falls back to GITHUB_TOKEN / GH_TOKEN, `gh auth login`, gh hosts.yml, or git credentials. |
